# Starting the default work with one empty message

A message whose body is `{}` wakes every structural root of an instance. It
takes the same path a typed message takes: it lands in the same ledger and opens
a frame.

## The template

Three structural roots, one node downstream of a root, and one node whose only
subscription is to a message type nothing sends.

```yaml
name: empty-wake-demo
version: "1"
messages:
  - type: never/sent
    body_schema: {type: object}
nodes:
  - type: root_one
    kind: attribute_passthrough
    attributes:
      schema: {type: object, properties: {v: {type: integer, default: 1}}}

  - type: root_two
    kind: attribute_passthrough
    attributes:
      schema: {type: object, properties: {v: {type: integer, default: 2}}}

  - type: root_three
    kind: attribute_passthrough
    attributes:
      schema: {type: object, properties: {v: {type: integer, default: 3}}}

  - type: downstream
    kind: attribute_passthrough
    subscribes:
      - node: root_one
        type: terminal/success
        force_upstream_refresh: false
    attributes:
      schema: {type: object, properties: {v: {type: integer, default: 1}}}

  - type: not_a_root
    kind: attribute_passthrough
    subscribes:
      - node: never/sent
        type: terminal/success
        force_upstream_refresh: false
    attributes:
      schema: {type: object, properties: {v: {type: integer, default: 1}}}
```

## Drive it

```bash
curl -sS -X POST "$BASE/v1/instances/$IID/messages" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -d '{}'
# 201
```

No type, no envelope fields.

## What the product does

All three structural roots dispatch exactly once.

The wake is targeted, not indiscriminate. `not_a_root` carries a declared
upstream, so the empty message does not wake it directly. `downstream` still
runs, by cascade from `root_one`. "Every structural root" means the roots, not
everything in the graph.

The empty send uses the ordinary delivery path:

```bash
curl -sS "$BASE/v1/instances/$IID/messages"
curl -sS "$BASE/v1/instances/$IID/frames"
```

The message is a row in the same ledger operators read for typed sends, it
carries the empty type (`""`), and it opened a frame whose triggering message is
that row.

Starting the default work is one call, with no envelope to craft.
